question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Great accomplishment includes enjoyment and liberation
Such accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
One possessing it may become dear to them
inference: A practitioner with the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
